title: chat-server: backend hooks for extension-bound Chat restrictions
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Chat.roomId and §message/mls require, for a Chat with a roomId: Message/set create -> invalidArguments; Message/set update changing body, bodyType or reactions -> invalidArguments; Chat/set update setting name, description, avatarBlobId or using addMembers/removeMembers/updateMemberRoles -> forbidden. The chat-server handlers have no backend gate where an extension can enforce per-Chat rules. Add may_* hooks (default permit, per JMAP-bghk fail-open decision) consulted by handle_message_set create/update and handle_chat_set update, passing the stored Chat and the patch keys. Generic: no MIMI knowledge in chat-server. Tests quote the mimi draft rules via a test backend that denies for a Chat with extra.roomId.
acceptance_criteria: Hooks exist with fail-open defaults; handlers call them after wire validation, before writes; integration tests cover each of the three rejection rules and the default-permit path.
notes:
Folded into JMAP-5mz6 (Chat extension seams in chat-server/chat-types) by the 2026-10-19 spec gap audit.
2026-10-20 spec 91672c9 changed mimi-00 L424: Message/set create in a room-bound Chat -> forbidden (not invalidArguments); body/bodyType/reactions update -> invalidProperties naming the changed properties (L426); client create with bodyType application/mimi-fanout -> invalidProperties [bodyType] (L430). Implement those codes.
